command:
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$workspace = (Get-Location).Path
& "$workspace\.forge-codex\instructions\scripts\Verify-Ledger.ps1" -WorkspaceRoot $workspace
$jsonPaths = @(
  '.forge-codex/state/run-state.json',
  '.forge-codex/state/evidence/P14/mcp-presence-continuity-status-checkpoint.json',
  '.forge-codex/state/commands/20260827T054234539Z-6c87f3b1.json',
  '.forge-codex/state/commands/20260827T054341785Z-c98598c5.json',
  '.forge-codex/state/commands/20260827T054406237Z-06b4e544.json',
  '.forge-codex/state/commands/20260827T054525831Z-137deddf.json',
  '.forge-codex/state/commands/20260827T054540604Z-35e385f2.json'
)
foreach ($relative in $jsonPaths) {
  $null = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath (Join-Path $workspace $relative) | ConvertFrom-Json
}
& "$workspace\.forge-codex\instructions\scripts\Validate-NoAttribution.ps1" -WorkspaceRoot $workspace
& "$workspace\.forge-codex\instructions\scripts\Validate-NoPython.ps1" -WorkspaceRoot $workspace
& git diff --check
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "git diff --check failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE." }
$textPaths = @()
$textPaths += @(git diff --name-only)
$textPaths += @(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)
$textPaths = $textPaths | Where-Object { $_ -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $_) } | Sort-Object -Unique
foreach ($relative in $textPaths) {
  $extension = [System.IO.Path]::GetExtension($relative).ToLowerInvariant()
  if ($relative -ne 'CMakeLists.txt' -and $extension -notin @('.cpp','.h','.md','.json','.jsonl','.txt','.ps1','.cmake','.tsv')) { continue }
  $path = Join-Path $workspace $relative
  $bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($path)
  if ($bytes.Length -ge 3 -and $bytes[0] -eq 0xef -and $bytes[1] -eq 0xbb -and $bytes[2] -eq 0xbf) {
    throw "$relative contains a UTF-8 BOM."
  }
  $text = [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false, $true).GetString($bytes)
  if ([regex]::IsMatch($text, '(?<!\r)\n|\r(?!\n)')) {
    throw "$relative contains a non-CRLF line ending."
  }
}
Write-Host "P14 presence and status checkpoint integrity validation passed."
